hit-death.scalePolicy: Single UPP per source sheet from standing reference poses; never normalize falling or lying image heights.

spell-interact.scalePolicy: Single UPP per source sheet from standing reference poses; never normalize falling or lying image heights.

dodge.issue: Entire sheet is near-opaque; true alpha background extraction required before geometry measurement or runtime use.

measurementPolicy: Read-only Pillow alpha/component measurements; PNG bytes unchanged. Hit/death uses independent >=16 connected components rather than equal grid crops; no other body component pixels appear inside any rect. Actions preserve previous frame indices, fps, phaseStarts and loop fields.

alphaAdvice.reason: Only alpha=7 faint gutter pixels can survive the existing 0.025 threshold on spell/interact; 8/255 would discard them if root wants a stricter cutoff. No threshold or manifest was changed. Dodge remains a separate true-alpha asset repair requirement.
